decision.reason: ANSA reports Italian ministry MASE studying extension of gradual electricity protections from 31 March to 31 December 2027 for small businesses and households. NOT approved law. Conditional scenario for retailers' notice/choice timeline and business transition cases; exclude automated official tariff selection and refrain from treating extension as enacted.

opportunities.target_customer: Italian electricity customer support organizations and microbusiness advisers
opportunities.core_job: Show households and microbusinesses how current March 2027 deadline versus proposed December extension could alter contract review and supplier-choice preparation
opportunities.product_mechanism: Manual existing contract and energy use figures, opt-in/customer status and the two alternative end dates, with nonbinding scenario label, to produce a reminder/notice checklist and hypothetical bill exposure
opportunities.why_now: ANSA reports Italian ministry MASE studying extension of gradual electricity protections from 31 March to 31 December 2027 for small businesses and households. NOT approved law. Conditional scenario for retailers' notice/choice timeline and business transition cases; exclude automated official tariff selection and refrain from treating extension as enacted.
opportunities.before_state: Consumers struggle to distinguish announced ministry study from current legally binding contract transition
opportunities.after_state: Separate current rules from proposed extension, document customer information steps without assuming the extension passed
